summary: An AI call spends most of its time waiting. async lets Python do other work while it waits, so three one-second calls can finish in about one second with asyncio.gather. Pydantic turns type hints into real runtime checks and raises a ValidationError on bad data.
goal: Make three slow calls finish in about one second with asyncio.gather, and validate data with a Pydantic model.

items.text: Read the Day 3 lesson (hook, three pieces, worked example)
Steps 1-2: run async_demo.py with asyncio.gather (about 1 second), then change it to three sequential awaits, predict the time and run it (about 3 seconds)
Step 3: uv add pydantic, run schemas.py, and read the ValidationError
Step 4: forget the await on purpose and read the warning
Step 5: add a temperature field (0 to 1) to ChatRequest and test 1.5
Play the Time Machine game to the end and see your score
